newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark revises c/a for 1996, Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Denmark revises c/a for 1996, Q1 1997.

text.p: Denmark's National Statistics Office on Wednesday revised upward its figure for the 1996 current account surplus to 14.8 billion crowns, from a previously published 12.3 billion.
The office also revised its first quarter 1997 figure to a 3.6 billion surplus from a previous 5.9 billion.
"As a result of changes in foreign trade data for 1996 and the months January to March 1997 there has been a revision of balance of payments statistics," the office said.
